runtime: Installed via Instalar-SonarStudio.ps1; shared Python runtime
processing: Python GUI plus Numba/LLVM nopython kernels, nogil, no fastmath; legacy fallback; not a C++ or Rust DLL
gpu: experimental pointwise OpenGL with framebuffer readback; RTX 3050 validated; freeze/export retain original CPU ordering
memory: readonly mmap sample views; assembled windows require copies; 64MiB block cache; 128MiB raw window limit
ai: existing sonar-specific four-class model unchanged; classification accuracy not certified
screen_export: displayed sonar viewports combined; optional selected-ping vessel GPS/depth/speed overlay; DownScan vertical panel beside SideScan; analysis scale retains zoom on navigation and resize; separate native capture retained
waypoints: Ctrl+W vessel GPS; Ctrl+Shift+W click SideScan estimated target; local findings with PNG and GPX export; C toggles synchronized cursor
safe_mode: SonarStudio-Legado.exe or --legacy disables JIT/GPU regardless of saved project
basemap: XYZ tiles opt-in (OSM default), disk cache 7 days, max 2 concurrent / 64 per view; no bulk prefetch
bathymetry_style: hillshade, banded palette, opacity, display-only Chaikin contours with along-line labels; grid unchanged
